tasks.label: Build Helium
args: shopt -s globstar nullglob && mkdir -p build && clang++ -std=c++20 -g $(pkg-config --cflags protobuf grpc++) -I/usr/include/grpcpp -I/usr/include  -I. -Isimulation -Isimulation/implementation -Igrpc_logging/proto/gen-cpp main.cpp simulation/**/*.cpp grpc_logging/proto/gen-cpp/*.cc grpc_logging/client/*.cpp testing/*.cpp $(pkg-config --libs protobuf grpc++) -lgtest -lpthread -o build/main.app
